recommendations.notes: Original: 9 N / 4.5 P2O5 / 5.7 K2O kg/10a (x10). RDA NICS standard cultivation method (농촌진흥청 표준재배법), machine-transplanted. Used identically in trial reports by 전남·충북·전북농업기술원.

Original product rates per 10a: basal 요소 10 kg + 용성인비 37 kg + 염화가리 6.3 kg; topdress after winter 요소 ~5 kg/10a. Nutrients DERIVED via standard guaranteed analysis (urea 46% N, fused phosphate 20% P2O5, KCl 60% K2O) — arithmetic, flagged. Southern-region recommendation.
recommendations.soilContext: Winter barley (맥류), southern-region; derived from product rates

recommendations.notes: Original: 8 kg N/10a (x10). N-only cross-check from the same MDPI Jeju study; consistent in magnitude with the Chungnam ARES rate (6.9 kg/10a N).

Original: 25.0 N / 7.7 P2O5 / 12.8 K2O kg/10a (x10). 유기질비료 표준시비량 (organic-fertilizer standard rate) from the Jeju 2019 field evaluation. Farm practice at the event was higher (40/10/11 kg/10a) — standard rate seeded.

Product schedule per 10a: 요소 65 kg + 염화가리 45 kg + 용성인비 100 kg (basal + 4 topdresses) -> ~30 N / 20 P2O5 / 27 K2O kg/10a (x10) via standard guaranteed analysis. DISCREPANCY: the same guide's nutrient text says 질소 20-26, 인산 12-20, 칼리 20-30 kg/10a — the two presentations do not convert exactly; both reproduced here, product-schedule values seeded with the discrepancy flagged.
recommendations.soilContext: Autumn/kimjang cabbage (가을배추), Busan-Gijang guide; product-schedule derived

recommendations.notes: Original: 인산 표준시비량 7.8 kg/10a (x10 = 78). Phosphate standard ONLY, from a Gangwon cabbage trial report. Differs from the Gijang guide's range — different soil/region context, not reconciled.
Original: 24 kg N/10a (x10). 'Standard N Fertilizer Usages' table. P2O5/K2O standard rates from an RDA or named Korean source were NOT found in accessible text — seeded N-only.
